notes.title: Measures against interruption of gameplay due to disconnections
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you for playing [b]DEATH NOTE Killer Within[/b].[/h3]

If a player other than the host, “Kira”, “Kira Follower”, or “L” leaves the room in the action phase or meeting phase due to disconnection or other reasons, the game will not be interrupted.

[b]▼Action Phase[/b]
If a living player other than the host, “Kira,” “Kira Follower,” or “L” disconnects, their avatar will not remain in the stage.
Disconnection during death will be treated the same as when a spectator leaves the room, and the player's corpse and dying message will remain in the stage.

[b]▼Meeting Phase[/b]
Players who disconnect without voting will be forced to skip voting.
L cannot choose to confiscate items from players who disconnect after the vote.

*Please note that players who disconnect intentionally or multiple times will be subject to warnings and bans. You can see the details [url=https://www.bandainamcoent.asia/sea/news/death-note-killer-within-disconnection-issues-patch]here[/url].

[h3]We look forward to your continued support for [b]DEATH NOTE Killer Within[/b].[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213190/DEATH_NOTE_Killer_Within/

notes.title: DEATH NOTE KILLER WITHIN COMING ON NOVEMBER 5th
notes.content:
[h2]DEATH NOTE Killer Within, the first-ever social deduction game based on the legendary anime series,  will be available on November 5th ![/h2]

[previewyoutube=qJ9ekWop694;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]DEATH NOTE Killer Within is an online social deduction game with cross-play support, where up to 10 players face a choice between life and death. Split into 2 teams, players must uncover each other’s identities to eliminate L or seize the Death Note from Kira. Kira and L are equally matched, each hiding their true identity while battling for control over the game. 

In DEATH NOTE Killer Within, players can assume one of four roles - Kira, Kira Follower, L, or Investigator - each offering unique gameplay characteristics. With each assigned role, players can develop a wide range of strategies, as randomized scenarios evolve into high-stakes games. 

Additionally, players can customize their nameplates, in-game avatars with up to seven types of accessories, and special effects displayed during key gameplay moments. [/h3]

[h2][b]Wishlist Now![/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213190/DEATH_NOTE_Killer_Within/
